title: Agora core test migration
head_binding_policy: The final PR head SHA is bound by REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at independent reviewer approval time via scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py. This evidence manifest does not claim a commit can contain its own SHA.

delivery_nature.statement: Decoupled all 17 test and support files in the Agora Core partition from the composition root (services/control-plane/bff/main.py), global monkeypatching (read_store, command_store), and sys.path surgery while preserving full test contracts, error schemas, and invariants.

p2_agora_router_health_production_seam.finding: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_router.py:292-294 added a test-only /health handler returning constant ok, reducing test_existing_bff_health_not_broken (line 760) to checking a fake handler rather than genuine production health behavior.
p2_agora_router_health_production_seam.resolution: Replaced test-only fake health handler with production seam create_core_router({}) from services.control_plane.bff.core.app_factory (the exact router included by bff/main.py for /health). Enhanced test_existing_bff_health_not_broken to verify the production health envelope ('status': 'ok', 'service': 'operator-bff', 'version', 'timestamp'). Verified with test_existing_bff_health_not_broken and architecture tests passing.

p2_manifest_reproducible_commands_and_su.finding: evidence.json:195-210 contained non-executable placeholder AST/audit commands, lacked a subprocess inventory/result and validated source-head SHA, and changed_files omitted test_agora_performance_transport_and_isolated_store.py, test_agora_research_candidate_governed.py, and test_agora_research_run_projection.py despite all three changing in the PR.
p2_manifest_reproducible_commands_and_su.resolution: Replaced placeholder commands with exact reproducible AST static scan and dynamic audit hook commands; added subprocess_scan section inventorying both subprocess sites in test_agora_chain_001_natural_owner_and_receipt.py (lines 668 and 679) including the retained subprocess sys.path bootstrap; reconciled changed_files to the full 18-file diff; recorded reviewed_head_sha (92c13bc9145008674126d838d7fdf0b48630f2b6) and delivery binding metadata.

p1_chain_natural_owner_main_fallback.finding: test_agora_chain_001_natural_owner_and_receipt.py:102 called _build_plan without workshop_store, causing _resolve_originating_correlation to fall back to dynamic import of main.py.
p1_chain_natural_owner_main_fallback.resolution: Injected test-local MemoryWorkshopStore() into _build_plan call at line 102 through the existing workshop_store keyword seam. Added test_build_plan_with_injected_workshop_store_makes_no_main_import_attempts verifying zero main import attempts. Verified with sys.addaudithook.

p2_route_specific_signal_and_bulk_feedba.finding: Router test fixtures wired require_agora_signal_write_role and require_agora_bulk_feedback_role to _require_operator_role, improperly rejecting analyst users with 403.
p2_route_specific_signal_and_bulk_feedba.resolution: Defined _require_agora_signal_write_role and _require_agora_bulk_feedback_role using _AGORA_SIGNAL_WRITE_ROLES and _AGORA_BULK_FEEDBACK_ROLES sets across all 11 router fixture files, enforcing exact ErrorCode.FORBIDDEN and role_check precondition failed envelopes. Added contract and regression tests verifying analyst acceptance and viewer rejection.

p2_manifest_and_scan_commands_evidence.finding: evidence.json lacked validated source head, used placeholder pytest command, omitted dynamic/subprocess scan commands and results, and omitted importer disposition/residuals.
p2_manifest_and_scan_commands_evidence.resolution: Updated manifest with exact origin/dev base SHA, full runnable pytest command with all 17 files listed explicitly, per-file breakdown matching live runs, dynamic audit hook and AST scan commands and results, and importer disposition table with zero residual main importers.

composition_root_references.notes: Zero import main or from main import across all 17 files.

sys_path_surgery.notes: All top-level sys.path.insert calls removed; package-qualified and try/except resilient fallback imports established.

global_monkeypatching.after: Zero global monkeypatching on composition root; test-scoped isolated router apps constructed with local ReadSurfacePorts doubles and test-local runtime state.

ast_static_scan.command: python3 -c "import ast, json, pathlib; paths = json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/deployment/evidence/BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B01-AGORA-CORE-001/evidence.json').read_text())['inventory']['files']; findings = [(p, n.lineno, ast.unparse(n)) for p in paths for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text())) if (isinstance(n, ast.Import) and any(a.name == 'main' or 'bff.main' in a.name for a in n.names)) or (isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and ((n.module or '') == 'main' or 'bff.main' in (n.module or '') or ((n.module or '').endswith('bff') and any(a.name == 'main' for a in n.names)))) or (isinstance(n, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(n.func).startswith('sys.path.'))]; print(json.dumps(findings))"

dynamic_audit_hook_scan.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -c "import sys, json, pathlib, pytest; paths = json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/deployment/evidence/BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B01-AGORA-CORE-001/evidence.json').read_text())['inventory']['files']; attempts = []; sys.addaudithook(lambda ev, args: attempts.append((ev, str(args[0]))) if ev == 'import' and (str(args[0]) == 'main' or 'bff.main' in str(args[0])) else attempts.append((ev, getattr(args[0], 'co_filename', ''))) if ev == 'exec' and str(getattr(args[0], 'co_filename', '')).replace('\\\\', '/').endswith('/bff/main.py') else None); code = pytest.main(['-q', '--tb=no', *paths]); print(f'MAIN_ATTEMPTS={len(attempts)}'); sys.exit(code or (1 if attempts else 0))"

subprocess_scan.command: python3 -c "import ast, json, pathlib; paths = json.loads(pathlib.Path('docs/deployment/evidence/BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B01-AGORA-CORE-001/evidence.json').read_text())['inventory']['files']; calls = [(p, n.lineno, ast.unparse(n)) for p in paths for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text())) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and any(s in ast.unparse(n.func) for s in ('import_module', '__import__', 'spec_from_file_location', 'subprocess.', 'Popen'))]; print(json.dumps(calls))"
